Memorandum.
POLICE FORCE,
MUNICIPAL COUNCIL,
Shanghai,....................193.......
To............................................................
LEVALD Verner, Danish, age-42
employee of the Greater Northern Tele-
graph Co.Ltd., 54 Av. Edw.VII.
Arrived in Shanghai in October 1928.
Residing at 175/6 Seymour Rd, Room 2.
Tel.37019. For some time worked at
Rice control office S.M.C.
He is a Chairman of the Danish Reading
Circle (organization of cultural
character of the members of local Danis
community, having library)
Married Russian girl Anne Levald
(nee-Zemliakova)

FM. 1
备忘录。
警务处，
工部局，
上海，....................193.......
致............................................................
LEVALD Verner，丹麦人，42岁
大北电报有限公司（Greater Northern Telegraph Co. Ltd.）职员，地址：爱多亚路（Av. Edw. VII）54号。
1928年10月抵沪。
现居西摩路（Seymour Rd）175/6号2室。
电话：37019。曾在工部局米业管制办公室工作一段时间。
他是丹麦读书会主席（该组织为当地丹麦侨民中具有文化性质的团体，设有图书馆）
娶俄国女子 Anne Levald（娘家姓 Zemliakova）为妻
